entry.name: pollInterval
entry.label: How often to ask for the current line, in milliseconds.

entry.name: player
entry.label: MPRIS player to query. Empty means auto-detect.

entry.name: showTimestamp
entry.label: Prefix every line with its timestamp.

entry.name: showIcon
entry.label: Show a note icon next to the lyrics.

entry.name: showTrackInfo
entry.label: Show the current track in the tooltip.

entry.name: pauseWhenIdle
entry.label: Stop polling while nothing is playing.

entry.name: placeholderText
entry.label: Text shown when there are no lyrics.

entry.name: maxCharacters
entry.label: Maximum amount of characters shown in the panel. 0 means no limit.
